visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The scene opens with a close-up of a young boy with short black hair wearing a bright red Mario-themed sweater. He is looking directly at the camera with a neutral expression in a brightly lit indoor restaurant setting with warm bokeh lights in the background. (2) The boy raises his right arm, covering his face with his red sleeve as he reacts playfully to an off-screen voice. The background remains a warm, slightly blurry restaurant interior with tables and other patrons visible in the distance. (3) The boy looks back at the camera and suddenly winces his face, squeezing his eyes shut tightly and opening his mouth in a wide, exaggerated smile or grimace. He is seated at a wooden table. (4) A wooden skewer featuring several small, red-glazed fruits (tanghulu) is brought into the frame. The boy leans in to take a bite, his mouth open wide, eyes focused on the food. (5) As he bites into the glazed fruit, his face contorts into a deep wince, eyes squeezed shut, and head tilted slightly. Red sauce or glaze is visible around his lips. (6) He continues chewing with his eyes tightly shut, his eyebrows furrowed in a strong physical reaction to the taste. He then sticks his tongue out, looking directly at the camera with a defiant yet strained expression. (7) He takes another large bite of the skewer, stretching his mouth wide. The camera remains in a steady close-up, capturing his intense facial expressions of wincing and then laughing with his mouth wide open, showing the chewed food inside.
